{{Top|italics=1}}
{{Quote|Sai tok roughly translates as "to cut body in half."|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Sai_Tok_GH_by_Drew_Baker.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] defeats a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] using ''sai tok'']]

In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], a '''''sai tok''''', frowned upon by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] because of its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-like nature, was the act of cutting an opponent in half, usually separating his or her legs from the [[Wikipedia:torso|torso]] at the [[Wikipedia:waist|waist]]. Sometimes, ''sai tok'' could vertically bisect an opponent too.

It was one of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] techniques known as The Marks of Contact.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Notable uses==
{{Quote|&hellip;Luke, you could have killed her. Cut her in two&hellip;|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] about [[Lumiya]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
[[File:NomiSaiTok.jpg|thumb|left|210px|[[Nomi Sunrider]] performs ''sai tok'' on [[Quanto]], slicing him from shoulder to hip.]]

Before even beginning any formal [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training, [[Nomi Sunrider]] took up her newly-deceased [[Andur Sunrider|husband's]] lightsaber, and literally "halved" the space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Quanto]], as described by his companion [[Gudb]]. Sunrider's use of ''sai tok'' was unique in that she cleaved Quanto lengthwise rather than through the waist.<ref name="TotJ 3">[[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref>

[[Unidentified Jedi (Myles' killer)|A Jedi]] used the strike on [[Myles]] during the [[Battle of Galidraan]].<ref name="Open Seasons 3">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 3|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 3]]</ref>

The [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] performed this maneuver when defeating [[Mighella]], [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] and bodyguard of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Lord/Legends|lord]] [[Alexi Garyn]].<ref name="Darth Maul 4">[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]]</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] also killed both the dark side Master [[Volfe Karkko]],<ref name="SW 1998 35">[[Star Wars (1998) 35|''Star Wars'' (1998) 35]]</ref> and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kadrian Sey]] in this manner.<ref name="JCD">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref>

[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] performed ''sai tok'' on three [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] during her [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)|journey]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]]. She bisected the MagnaGuard with a cloak on vertically and the others horizontally.<ref name="The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] defeated an assassin droid using ''sai tok'' at [[Phindar Spaceport]] during the [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|Mission to Vjun]], cleaving his opponent cleanly in two.<ref name="Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

During their final duel on board the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would have received a ''sai tok'' from Darth Vader had Kenobi's body not disappeared into [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] upon his death.<ref name="SWANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[File:Rapacious_Malice.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Twi'lek [[darksider]] destroys a pillar along with her victim using ''sai tok'']]

Vader also used the technique to kill several members of a [[hyenax]] pack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]], including the pack's leader.<ref name="Emp14">[[Empire 14|''Empire'' 14]]</ref>

Klatoonian [[Barada/Legends|Barada]] received a ''sai tok'' strike from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in a [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|sarlacc]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

Despite having no Jedi training, as well as his [[Horn family|family's]] weakness in [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic prowess]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] succeeded in performing ''sai tok'' on a member of the [[Imperial Center People's Militia]] via Saber Throw. This feat is all the more remarkable since he had only come across his [[Nejaa Halcyon|grandfather]]'s [[Nejaa Halcyon's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and learned of his heritage in the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]].<ref name="Krytos">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Dark Jedi [[Vill Goir]] died from a ''sai tok'' strike, severed from left shoulder to right torso, delivered by Jedi [[Kam Solusar]] during their duel on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="DEII3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>

Soon after, while confronting Dark Jedi [[Krdys Mordi]] on [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] in defense of Master Luke Skywalker, [[Jem Ysanna]] killed Mordi through use of ''sai tok''. During that same battle, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] performed the same maneuver against [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Tedryn-Sha]], slicing him from his left shoulder down to his right waist.<ref name="DEII6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref>

During his final test in [[Brakiss]]' [[Shadow Academy]], [[Zekk]] executed a last-minute ''sai tok'' on [[Vilas]] when the other Dark Jedi tried to strike him from behind.<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>

During the [[duel in the Dathomir landing meadow]], [[Ben Skywalker]] killed a [[Sith Saber]] by performing ''sai tok''.

An [[unidentified Aqualish Sith|Aqualish Sith]] received a ''sai tok'' strike from Master [[Wolf Sazen]] in [[137 ABY]].

The same year, [[Vul Isen]] was sliced in half by [[Cade Skywalker]] while trying to poison [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau's]] water supply.<ref name="Leg50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>

==Survival cases==
{{Quote|You know, when I cut you in half, I should have aimed for your ''neck'' instead.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Maulhalved-tpm4.jpg|thumb|left|170px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] is defeated through [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] use of ''sai tok''.]]
In rare instances, it was possible however for the recipient of ''sai tok'' to survive, either by use of the Force or some other means.

One such case is that in an impressive display of lightsaber technique, Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used ''sai tok'' to defeat Darth Maul during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]].<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="SWAOTC">{{Film|I}}</ref> Maul, however, survived, his spirit kept intact by his intense feelings of hatred fueling the dark side of the Force, and escaped to [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], replacing his severed lower body with a 6-legged cybernetic apparatus via the Force.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> This shabby replacement was replaced years later by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] with two legs similar to that of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Revenge" /> Shortly after, they were replaced by [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

Another example would be the Dark Jedi [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]], who received a ''sai tok'' from Jedi Master [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]]. Maw managed to survive this usually fatal attack by drawing on his anger through the dark side of the Force. His new disfigurement consequently made him a prime candidate for a completely unique form of lightsaber combat: [[Trispzest]].

One other classic example would be General Grievous when his cybernetic apparatus was severed by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. The general managed to survive and escaped the Jedi. Soon after, [[EV-A4-D/Legends|EV-A4-D]] replaced his legs.<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref>
